items.title: Farm Tycoon
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Become a farm tycoon! Craft seeds to grow corn, peppers, strawberries, and more; then sell your produce at the nearby market. Use your profits to buy vehicles like a bulldozer, and clear out trees to expand your farm.
- 10 crops to grow
- 7 new tools
- 7 utility buildings
- Cat and dog pets
- Survival, roleplay, or multiplayer fun
- 5 skins

Get growing!

items.title: Among Sus 3
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Aliens and astronauts travel among the stars. Who among these space travelers are trustworthy? That green alien sure is suspicious! Or maybe the cute astronauts are the real masterminds. Find out who among you can be trusted and who among you are pure evil!

- 13 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Fire Force
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Attention! Fire monsters have taken over the city! Fortunately, firefighters come into action. Join a group of brave firefighters and overcome the danger! Become a hero and save the city from the flames!

- Best for roleplay 
- HD skins 
- Become a brave firefighter 
- by CribSon

items.title: Angel & Demon Teens
items.creator: The Hive
items.description:
Which side will you choose? Fly through the sky as an angel, or menace in the shadows as a demon?

+ 8 angel skins
+ 8 demon skins
+ 8 yin and yang skins
+ HD details for extra cuteness
+ By: The Hive

items.title: Secret Agent Mobs
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Sing it with me now. Secret agent mobs! Secret agent mobs! There, you should feel like a secret agent by now! No? Well at least you have these secret agent mobs to choose from! Choose from six different secret mob agents, and get out there! Sunglasses version included, for extra secret agent roleplay.

- 12 secret agent mob skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: UwU
items.creator: Lebleb
items.description:
For those moments when something is just so cute you have no words, the only thing you can send is "uwu."

This skin pack includes 18 HD "uwu" inspired skins!

items.title: School City
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
School is officially in session! Go to class and find new friends. Don't forget to visit the city after and take a tour by bus!

+ Interactable furniture!
+ Drivable bus!
+ Fully decorated school and city!
+ Perfect for student roleplay!
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Mob Hunters
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Dangerous giant zombies have attacked the city. Our soldiers need support! Join a special unit and defeat enemy forces! Defend the city and become a hero!
- 12 anime inspired skins 
- Perfect for roleplay

items.title: City Careers
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Life in the city means you need a career! What job do you want? You can be whatever you want. Whether that's a fast food worker, waiter, or even a boss! These skins are perfect for roleplay in any mega city adventure!

- Skins for teens
- Perfect for roleplay
- City careers
- 20 skins

items.title: Lucky Skyblock Isekai Forest
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Lucky blocks are something magical in this new world! They can be plenty helpful or terribly annoying at any given moment. Probably just your luck though! See what your luck entails in this magical forest of the new world!

- 10 new lucky blocks!
- Over 100 lucky or unlucky events!
- Custom survival skyblock spawn!
- 8 HD teen role-playing skins!

items.title: Modern Gamer Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Use the latest, modern gamer skins and reunite the squad for a great experience!
Take your gaming career to the next level and become one of the most modern gamers on the planet!

+ 6 modern gamer teens, ready to play their favourite games with friends!
+ The most modern gamer skins & the coolest vibes - what else could you ask for?

items.title: Nether Ore Blocks
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
The ore blocks are back, this time in the Nether world!
Prepare to meet 33 different styles of nether derps, in just a single skin pack.

+ Mega pack containing 33 cute derp skins, depicting nether ore blocks!
+ Providing you with great fashion style everywhere around the nether, no matter the block you choose.
+ 2 FREE skins included!

items.title: Comic Teens
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
It's time to pick a side. Will you become a hero or a villain?

+ 10 HD superhero teen skins
+ Awesome outfits
+ 2 FREE skins!

items.title: Anime Neko Teens
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Start living your life in anime neko or K-pop style with cute tiny ears and tail. In this top anime neko skinpack full of colors, adopt a cat and roleplay in your favorite anime city, hold a costume dance party or discover a flower garden in Japan. Become your favorite neko teen character and impress your friends!

+ 10 colorful kins
+ 2 free skins

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Paleocraft
items.creator: CompyCraft
items.description:
Welcome to Paleocraft!
Journey back in time over 65 million years to the age of the dinosaurs! Explore a forgotten island and experience over 100 prehistoric creatures!

+ Over 100 new creatures
+ 15 new vehicles
+ 12 exclusive skins
+ Huge dinosaur island

items.title: Sharks
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Become a legendary shark explorer! Explore the tropical island and dive into a vast aquatic life. Find, defeat or play with the sharks.

+ 11 Sharks 
+ 3 Vehicle 
+ Multiplayer 
+ Lucky crates 
+ 7 custom items 
+ Over 50 new textures

items.title: Anime Ninjas
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
The ninja clans are at war! Become a stealthy ninja and choose your ninja style! Perfect for scouting missions, or infiltrating your friend's base!

- 8 different skins!
- Variety of outfit designs and colours, ideal for stealth missions!

items.title: Young Gru
items.creator: Minecraft
items.description: They grow so despicably fast!

items.title: Fantasy Warriors
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
For hundreds of years, arcane schools have trained magicians into becoming skilled warriors. Now, war has broken out between the school's most powerful former students...

- 1 free skin included
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: Cyberpups
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Cyberpunk but with puppies! Be the coolest puppy in your post-apocalyptic world. 

- 10 robotic skins with cute dogs expressions
- Glow in neon colors
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from PSB.

items.title: Silly Faces
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Express yourself freely with these silly skins.

- Unique faces like no other: rolling eyes, ugly smile, LOL, and biting lips.
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from PSB.

items.title: Hacker Base
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Pixel Creations presents: Hacker Base! Are you tired of the pro base? Explore hacker base with many rooms and amazing things for survival. Become a major hacker in the team and enjoy this awesome house.

- 5 underground levels.
- Secret vault.
- Hacker rooms.
- Laboratories.
- 6 HD skins.
- Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Dream Sleepover Attire

items.description:
Have fun while looking your best! With 15 fashionable modern outfits that range from teens to animals you can freely be whatever you desire while being the life of the party. Are you ready to dream away in this comfy pack?

- 15 HD skins
- Animals and teens

These FIRE skins are flaming hot!

FIRE by: Pickaxe Studios
